Live Preview float prototype

This isolated DOM experiment applies a float inside a block widget. It uses no CodeMirror engine and cannot validate cursor mapping, editing, height measurement, scrolling, selection or undo. The shipped plugin uses the centered fallback.

Board widget
Adjacent editable paragraph. Floating the widget changes visual text flow, while the editor's source lines and block-widget boundaries are unchanged. A real CM6 integration needs cursor and height-map validation inside Obsidian.
